name: com.surplusmargin/surplusmargin-mcp
description: Gov surplus auction net-margin calculator, Max Safe Hammer Bid, NHTSA VIN & turf comp lookup.

tools.name: search_surplus_deals
tools.description: Search SurplusMargin's D1 database of closed government surplus steals and live sleeper auctions (GSA, GovDeals, Municibid, PublicSurplus, GovPlanet) with all-in net profit after buyer premiums, sales tax, card fees, and towing. Live agency URLs and lot IDs are redacted on keyless calls.

tab.description: Deal feed tab: 'closed' for verified past steals (full details) or 'live' for active sleeper auctions (redacted URLs on keyless tier). Defaults to 'closed'.

zip.description: Optional 5-digit US ZIP code to sort and compute distance in miles from the lot.

category.description: Optional asset category filter. Defaults to 'all'.

min_net_profit_dollars.description: Optional minimum estimated net profit in USD (e.g. 1500).

limit.description: Maximum number of deals to return (1-25, default 10).

tools.name: calculate_all_in_margin
tools.description: Run SurplusMargin's exact government auction all-in landed cost calculator (buyer's premium + sales tax on hammer and premium + card fee + SF-97/title fees + tow + selling fees) and backward-solve the clearfills Max Safe Hammer Bid to avoid negative-margin traps.

agency.description: Auction platform/agency fee profile: 'gsa' (0% premium), 'municibid' (8.5%), 'publicsurplus' (10%), 'govdeals' (12.5%), or 'govplanet' (15% + $125 SF-97).

hammer_bid_dollars.description: Winning or target hammer bid in USD (e.g. 4000).

sold_comp_dollars.description: Verified realized resale comp price in USD (e.g. 5000).

state_tax_pct.description: Combined state + municipal sales tax percentage (e.g. 7 for 7.0%). Defaults to 7.0%.

selling_channel.description: Resale channel: 'local_fb' (0% fee), 'dealer_wholesale' (5% fee), or 'ebay' (13% fee). Defaults to 'ebay'.

tow_dollars.description: Estimated towing, transport, or freight cost in USD. Defaults to 300.

tools.name: decode_fleet_vin
tools.description: Run a live NHTSA vPIC VIN decode for a 17-character vehicle VIN and compute SurplusMargin's commercial fleet wholesale comp range with an explicit -15% municipal idle-hour haircut and diesel/4WD adjustments.

vin.description: 17-character alphanumeric VIN (excluding I, O, Q), e.g. '1FT7W2BT5LEC45123'.

tools.name: lookup_turf_comp
tools.description: Query SurplusMargin's 49-model canonical D1 municipal turf & compact machinery comp index (Kubota, John Deere, Toro, Scag, Exmark, Bobcat, Vermeer, etc.) with typo normalization and hour-band matching.

query.description: Equipment make/model query (handles common municipal typos like 'Kuboda RTV X1100C' or 'Toro Groundmaster 3280D').

hours.description: Optional engine/meter hours to match the exact hour-band comp tier.
